discovery_notes: Licensed-other 2020-2021 sweep, 30 standard search-snippet queries. Recorded FiGPiN Star Wars/Marvel/Big Hero 6 releases (Luke #504, Mandalorian deluxe box, waves 1-2, Walmart black/silver, Season 2, EE and Walmart Baymax XL, WandaVision, Falcon and Winter Soldier), Funko (Deadpool Pop! Pins 2021, SDCC 2020 and Fall Virtual Con The Child, Walmart 4-pin packs), Hallmark PXL8 The Child, EE Clone Wars 4-pin set, Bioworld No Way Home 3-pack, SalesOne/Toynk WandaVision set, Mondo Fantastic Four and Goose, Her Universe Star Wars pins sold at Disney Parks/shopDisney (2020 share packs, Dec 2020 wave, 2021 Series 2), and Hot Topic single pins with unstated maker. Existing 2020 Funko keys in packet 225 (jumbo series, Iron Man virtual con) not duplicated. Princess Funko Walmart set held for pin structure; Lock Shock Barrel set held. Kingpins/BigBadToyStore are retailer listings used only for FiGPiN numbers.
